_how_to_edit: Each question needs: 'question', exactly 4 'choices', 'answer' (the letter A, B, C or D of the correct choice, counted in the order you write them) and an optional short 'explain'. Answers are shuffled when shown, so the position doesn't matter. Keep it to general AI and Web3 knowledge: facts about N7X itself belong in facts.md, not here. The bot re-reads this file automatically, no restart needed. Check your edits at https://jsonlint.com if /trivia says the file is broken.

questions.question: What does "LLM" stand for?
questions.explain: LLMs like the ones behind chatbots are trained on huge amounts of text to predict and generate language.

questions.question: In AI agents, what is a "tool call"?
choices: The model asking the app to run an outside function or API
A phone call made by the AI
questions.explain: Agents become useful by calling tools: search, calculators, databases, other APIs.

questions.question: What is a "multi-agent system"?
choices: Several AI agents working together on a task
questions.explain: For example, one agent plans, another researches and another checks the work.

questions.question: What does "RAG" mean in AI?
questions.explain: RAG looks up relevant documents first, then lets the model answer using them.

questions.question: When an AI "hallucinates", it...
choices: States something false as if it were true
questions.explain: That's why good AI systems check facts against trusted sources.

questions.question: The Transformer architecture behind modern LLMs was introduced in which 2017 paper?
questions.explain: Written by researchers at Google, it introduced the attention-based Transformer.

questions.question: For a language model, what is a "token"?
choices: A small chunk of text the model reads and writes
A crypto coin the model mines
questions.explain: A token is often a word or part of a word. Models have limits measured in tokens.

questions.question: What is a model's "context window"?
choices: The maximum amount of text it can consider at once
The app window it runs in
The time of day it works best
The list of languages it speaks
questions.explain: Anything beyond the context window is invisible to the model in that moment.

questions.question: What does "fine-tuning" a model mean?
choices: Training a pretrained model further on specific data
Running it on a faster computer
questions.explain: Fine-tuning adapts a general model to a specific task or style.

questions.question: What is "prompt injection"?
choices: Hidden instructions in input that try to hijack an AI's behavior
A faster way to type prompts
Adding more GPUs to a server
questions.explain: It's a key security risk for AI agents that read web pages, emails or messages.

questions.question: Since "The Merge" in 2022, which consensus mechanism does Ethereum use?
questions.explain: Validators stake ETH instead of miners using energy-hungry hardware.

questions.question: What is a "smart contract"?
choices: A program on a blockchain that runs automatically when its conditions are met
A legal contract signed with a smart pen
A phone plan for crypto users
questions.explain: Once deployed, its code runs exactly as written, which is why audits matter.

questions.question: What does "DAO" stand for?
questions.explain: DAOs let members vote on decisions, often using tokens.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of bitcoins that will ever exist?
questions.explain: The 21 million cap is built into Bitcoin's rules.

questions.question: Who published the Bitcoin whitepaper in 2008?
questions.explain: Satoshi Nakamoto is a pseudonym. Their real identity is still unknown.

questions.question: What does "NFT" stand for?
questions.explain: Non-fungible means each token is unique and not interchangeable with another.

questions.question: On Ethereum, what is a "gas fee"?
choices: A fee paid to process a transaction or run a smart contract
The price of fuel for mining rigs
A fee for creating an email
questions.explain: Gas measures the computation a transaction needs.

questions.question: What is a wallet "seed phrase"?
choices: A list of words that can restore a crypto wallet
A promo code for free tokens
questions.explain: Anyone with your seed phrase controls your funds. Never share it, not even with "support".

questions.question: What is a "Layer 2" in blockchain?
choices: A network built on top of a main chain to make transactions faster and cheaper
A backup copy of a wallet
questions.explain: Rollups are a popular kind of Layer 2.

questions.question: What does "DeFi" stand for?
questions.explain: DeFi apps offer lending, trading and more using smart contracts instead of banks.

questions.question: What is a "stablecoin"?
choices: A token designed to keep a steady value, often pegged to a currency like the US dollar
A coin that never moves between wallets
A coin that can only be mined in stables
questions.explain: Stability isn't guaranteed: it depends on how the stablecoin is backed.

questions.question: In crypto, what is a "rug pull"?
choices: When a project's creators run off with investors' money
A way to clean your hardware wallet
questions.explain: Anonymous teams, unaudited contracts and heavy hype are common warning signs.

questions.question: What do Bitcoin miners do?
choices: Compete to add new blocks by solving computational puzzles
questions.explain: This is called Proof of Work. Miners earn new bitcoin and fees as a reward.

questions.question: What does "HODL" mean in crypto slang?
choices: Holding on to crypto instead of selling
questions.explain: It started as a typo of "hold" in a 2013 forum post and became a meme.

questions.question: Which programming language is most commonly used for Ethereum smart contracts?
questions.explain: Solidity was designed specifically for the Ethereum Virtual Machine.

questions.question: What is a blockchain "oracle"?
choices: A service that brings outside data, like prices, onto the blockchain
A fortune teller who predicts prices
The first miner on a network
A wallet with a huge balance
questions.explain: Smart contracts can't read the internet by themselves, so oracles feed them data.
